title: Phosphor
summary: PHOS'PHOR, noun [Gr. light, to shine, and to bring. See Phosphorus.] The morning star or Lucifer; Venus, when it precedes the sun and shines in the morning. In this sense, it is also written Phosphoru

inlines.v: PHOS'PHOR, noun [Gr. light, to shine, and to bring. See Phosphorus.] The morning star or Lucifer; Venus, when it precedes the sun and shines in the morning. In this sense, it is also written Phosphorus.
